description: This file implements a call graph directed acyclic graph (DAG) for functions, including classes and methods for creating, traversing, and analyzing function call relationships, with focus on topological order and recursion detection.

classes.name: CallDAG::CallDAGCreator
classes.description: Helper class for creating and analyzing the call graph, including assigning indices to functions, detecting recursion, and building data structures.

classes.name: CallDAG
classes.description: Represents a call graph DAG of functions, providing initialization, querying, and management of function call relationships.

methods.name: assignIndices
methods.description: Assigns indices to functions in the call graph, skipping unimplemented functions.

methods.name: fillDataStructures
methods.description: Fills records and mapping structures with function call data.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the call DAG from a root node, performing traversal, topological sort, and recursion detection.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Finds the index of a function given its unique ID.

methods.name: getRecordFromIndex
methods.description: Retrieves a function call record by index.
